props.name: tabs
props.description: Tab data array. Order defines visual order.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual style of the tab list.
- "underline" (default): active tab shows a bottom indicator line
- "segmented": active tab renders as a filled pill
- "solid": active tab renders with a solid block background

props.name: selectedIndex
props.description: Controlled selected index — pair with onChange

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Layout direction of the tab list.
- "horizontal" (default): tabs sit in a row above the panel
- "vertical": tabs sit in a column to the left of the panel

props.name: stretch
props.description: Stretch tabs to fill equal width across the tab list (horizontal only)

props.name: listClass
props.description: Extra classes for the TabList wrapper

props.name: panelsClass
props.description: Extra classes for the TabPanels wrapper
